import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useShareIntentContext } from 'expo-share-intent';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthProvider';
import { isValidUrl } from '../lib/platform';

/**
 * Global share-intent consumer. Instagram / browser shares land here no
 * matter which screen is open: the URL is routed into the Save flow
 * (auto-save when signed in, sign-in first when not). Lives at the root
 * layout so it works on Android cold start and warm start, where the
 * ACTION_SEND intent never produces a deep-link path.
 */
function extractSharedUrl(text: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!text) return null;
  const match = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+/i)?.[0];
  if (!match) return null;
  const url = match.replace(/[),.;!?]+$/, '');
  return isValidUrl(url) ? url : null;
}

export default function ShareIntentBridge() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isLoaded, isSignedIn } = useAuth();
  const { isReady, hasShareIntent, shareIntent, resetShareIntent, error } = useShareIntentContext();
  const handled = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isReady) return;

    if (error) {
      // Native module could not read the share payload — show the explanation once.
      if (handled.current !== 'error') {
        handled.current = 'error';
        resetShareIntent();
        router.replace({ pathname: '/shareintent', params: { reason: 'parse' } });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!hasShareIntent) {
      handled.current = null; // share consumed — allow the next one
      return;
    }

    const key = `${shareIntent.webUrl ?? ''}|${shareIntent.text ?? ''}`;
    if (handled.current === key) return;
    if (!isLoaded) return; // wait for auth state before routing
    handled.current = key;

    const url = shareIntent.webUrl && isValidUrl(shareIntent.webUrl)
      ? shareIntent.webUrl
      : extractSharedUrl(shareIntent.text);

    if (!url) {
      resetShareIntent();
      router.replace({ pathname: '/shareintent', params: { reason: 'nolink' } });
      return;
    }

    if (isSignedIn) {
      router.replace({ pathname: '/save', params: { url, source: 'share_extension' } });
    } else {
      router.replace({ pathname: '/(auth)/sign-in', params: { shareUrl: url } });
    }
    // Reset after navigation so the effect doesn't re-fire on the cleared state.
    resetShareIntent();
  }, [error, hasShareIntent, isLoaded, isReady, isSignedIn, resetShareIntent, router, shareIntent]);

  return null;
}

Fixed. Here's what was wrong and what changed:

## Root cause

The share flow relied on a dedicated `/shareintent` screen to consume the shared URL. But that screen only got mounted on **iOS cold start**, where the share extension posts a `keepitback://dataUrl=…` deep link that `redirectSystemPath` routed to it. On **Android**, Instagram shares arrive as an `ACTION_SEND` intent (`text/plain`) — the native module reads the payload and sets `shareIntent` state, but **nothing ever routes to `/shareintent`**, so the shared URL sat unconsumed in the provider context while the app opened on whatever screen it was on. Nothing saved. Warm-start on iOS had the same gap, plus a navigation race in the old screen: it called `resetShareIntent()` (flipping `hasShareIntent` to false) and then the effect re-ran and did `router.replace('/')` — yanking the user off the save screen mid-save.

## Fix

1. **[app/_layout.tsx](app/_layout.tsx) — new `ShareIntentBridge`** mounted at the root (inside `AuthProvider`), so the share intent is consumed on **any screen, on both platforms, cold or warm start**. It:
   - waits for auth to load, then routes signed-in users to `/save?url=…&source=share_extension` (auto-save kicks in) and signed-out users to sign-in, which continues to `/save` afterwards;
   - extracts the URL from either `shareIntent.webUrl` or the first `https://…` in shared text (Instagram shares caption + URL as plain text on Android);
   - resets the intent **after** navigation and guards against re-delivered payloads with a content-keyed ref — no more mid-save bounce to home.
2. **[app/shareintent.tsx](app/shareintent.tsx)** — rewritten as a static explanation screen ("No web link was found in the shared content." / "Could not read the shared content.") driven by route params; it no longer consumes the share context.
3. **[app/+native-intent.ts](app/+native-intent.ts)** — routes the iOS `dataUrl=` deep link to `/` instead of `/shareintent`, since the bridge now decides where to go.

## Verification

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — 0 errors
- `npx expo lint` — 0 errors

One thing to know: `expo-share-intent` uses native code, so this must be tested on a **development build** (`npx expo run:android` / `eas build --profile development`) — share intents never fire in Expo Go. The existing flow — signed-in → auto-save → item screen, signed-out → sign-in → save — is preserved, including the existing duplicate-URL handling.
